subject: Copywriting
title: EXTRA! EXTRA! The Art of the Scream
description: A micro-lesson that makes EXTRA! EXTRA! The Art of the Scream usable.

hook.text: 'DEWEY DEFEATS TRUMAN'—the most famous wrong headline ever. Printed in 1948, wrong by morning.

buildup.text: Newspaper headlines had to sell on newsstands. They competed with every other paper on the rack.

discovery.text: Tabloids mastered the art: big type, punchy verbs, emotional words. 'HEADLESS BODY IN TOPLESS BAR' is legend.

twist.text: Broadsheets considered tabloid headlines beneath them. But readers bought tabloids. Attention beats dignity.

climax.text: The New York Post's headline writers became celebrities. Their front pages were shared like memes, decades early.

punchline.text: Sell papers in six words. Tabloids wrote the playbook.

quiz.question: What made the 'DEWEY DEFEATS TRUMAN' headline famous?
